|lore=Mysterious bounty hunter of an unknown species. Rumored to be somewhat telepathic. Infrequent member of Jabba’s court. Plotting to kill Jabba.
|game_text=Once per game, you may add X to a Force drain, where X = the value of X on Firepower (V). While at a battleground, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses at same and related planet sites may not be canceled. Blaster Rifle is a “matching weapon” for Bane. Immune to attrition < 3.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Bane Malar (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Bane Malar (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 1, slip 12 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “Once per game, you may add X to a Force drain, where X = the value of X on Firepower (V). Your Force drains and Force drain bonuses at same and related planet sites may not be canceled. Blaster Rifle is a “matching weapon” for Bane. Immune to attrition < 3.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 4 FORCE-SENSITIVE”. Deploy 2, forfeit 4. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•12” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 5 December 2004; PDF dated 12 October 2004), page 1, slip 12, on the same old slip: “Once per game, you may add X to a Force drain, where X = the value of X on Firepower (V). While at a battleground, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses at same and related planet sites may not be canceled. Blaster Rifle is a “matching weapon” for Bane. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' “Your” became “While at a battleground, your”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bane Malar (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 12), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Blaster Rifle is a matching weapon for Bane. While at a battleground planet site, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here and at same site as Ree-Yees may not be canceled. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
